title: Fence along one wall · Set 2
statement:
With $4([$a])$ m of fencing and one side along an existing wall, find the optimal perpendicular side length.

[__________]{a}
hints: Two equal perpendicular sides use fencing.
Maximize the area on the feasible interval.
solution: $A=4([$a])x-2x^2$ on $[0,2[$a]]$. Its derivative changes from positive to negative at $x=[$a]$.

feedback.message: Maximize the area on the feasible interval.
